purpose: Finite-budget sensitivity of conditional coverage to the attainable slope gap (Proposition 2); not an asymptotic proof or operator-versus-trace experiment
design_status: Fixed before this new run; informed by existing manuscript and earlier experiments, not study-wide prospective preregistration
X: (1,sqrt(2)cos(2pi*i/N)); identical for all methods and k
f: 0, fixed before labels; theory mechanism only, no claim of useful prediction performance
field: Delta=Zc*sqrt(2)cos(2pi*(L+1)*i/N)+Zs*sqrt(2)sin(2pi*(L+1)*i/N)+sigma*epsilon, L=4k+3; Zc,Zs independent N(0,k^-a); epsilon iid N(0,1)
population: all N periodic grid sites; no masks or exclusions
rng: numpy PCG64 via SeedSequence([master_seed,k,field,stream]); stream0 field, stream1 labels; uniforms shared across all n and methods within k/field/label; k cells use separate draws
penalty: normalized Lambda=0 through k; (h/k)^4 above k; Gamma=n*Lambda fixed; no tuning or candidate selection
covariance: complete inclusion derivative non-FPC for feasible estimates; known-pi design variance estimate with FPC for HT; oracle population linearization V for diagnostics only
failure_policy: preserve every attempt and reason; no redraw, pseudoinverse, clipping or adaptive ridge; invalid joint regions count as noncoverage, marginal invalidity separately counted
uncertainty: field-cluster MCSE: SD of field-level coverage / sqrt(16); nested independent labels within fields; paired comparisons use field-level paired differences
resources: single BLAS thread, sequential; estimate under 1 GiB RAM and under 0.5 GiB output; checkpoint each cell/field; interrupted attempts logged, do not silently extend repetitions
pilot: first k,n,field,label deterministic pipeline check on same frozen inputs; engineering check/replay, not additional replicate or independent validation
